description: This file implements a Jira connector class for integrating with Atlassian Jira APIs. It provides methods for authentication, searching issues, creating issues, and retrieving metadata about projects. The class extends a base connector and uses Pydantic models for URL and data schema definitions.

classes.name: JiraConnector
classes.description: A connector class for interfacing with Jira via Atlassian Cloud APIs, supporting search, create, and metadata functionalities.

methods.name: ConnectorDescriptor descriptor(self)
methods.description: Returns metadata about the connector, including capabilities and documentation URLs.

methods.name: List[AuthStrategy] auth_strategies(self)
methods.description: Returns the list of authentication strategies supported by this connector.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] apply_auth(self, headers: Dict[str, str], *, auth: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Applies authentication headers to outgoing requests based on provided auth information.

methods.name: SearchResponse search(self, req: SearchRequest)
methods.description: Stub method to perform a search query on Jira issues, returning a list of matching items.

methods.name: CreateResponse create(self, req: CreateRequest)
methods.description: Stub method to create a new Jira issue, returning metadata about the created issue.

methods.name: MetadataResponse metadata(self, req: MetadataRequest)
methods.description: Returns metadata information such as available projects for Jira.

ctags.name: apply_auth
ctags.pattern: /^    def apply_auth(self, headers: Dict[str, str], *, auth: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, str]:$/
ctags.signature: (self, headers: Dict[str, str], *, auth: Dict[str, Any])

ctags.name: create
ctags.pattern: /^    async def create(self, req: CreateRequest) -> CreateResponse:$/

ctags.name: metadata
ctags.pattern: /^    async def metadata(self, req: MetadataRequest) -> MetadataResponse:$/

ctags.name: search
ctags.pattern: /^    async def search(self, req: SearchRequest) -> SearchResponse:$/
